proof_body:
by
  intro f C k hf hb
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    have := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hb 0)
    simpa using this
  have hv : ∀ n, k < n → iteratedDeriv n f 0 = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    by_contra hne
    have hpos : 0 < ‖iteratedDeriv n f 0‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
    have key : ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ‖iteratedDeriv n f 0‖ ≤ n.factorial * (C * 2 ^ k) / R := by
      intro R hR
      have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
      have hs : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) R, ‖f z‖ ≤ C * (2 * R) ^ k := by
        intro z hz
        have hz' : ‖z‖ = R := by simpa using hz
        refine (hb z).trans ?_
        rw [hz']
        gcongr
        linarith
      have h1 := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le n hR0 (hf.diffContOnCl (s := Metric.ball 0 R)) hs
      refine h1.trans ?_
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, n = k + 1 + d := ⟨n - (k + 1), by omega⟩
      have hRd : 1 ≤ R ^ d := one_le_pow₀ hR
      rw [mul_pow, pow_add, pow_add, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hR0]
      have hA : 0 ≤ ((k + 1 + d).factorial : ℝ) * (C * (2 ^ k)) := by positivity
      have : ((k + 1 + d).factorial : ℝ) * (C * (2 ^ k * R ^ k)) * R = ((k + 1 + d).factorial : ℝ) * (C * 2 ^ k) * (R ^ k * R) := by ring
      rw [this]
      have h3 : R ^ k * R ^ 1 ≤ R ^ k * R ^ 1 * R ^ d := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hRd
      simpa [pow_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hA
    have hlim := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop (Filter.tendsto_id (α := ℝ) (x := Filter.atTop)) (a := (n.factorial : ℝ) * (C * 2 ^ k))
    have : ‖iteratedDeriv n f 0‖ ≤ 0 := by
      refine ge_of_tendsto hlim ?_
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with R hR using key R hR
    exact absurd hpos (not_lt.mpr this)
  refine ⟨∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), Polynomial.C (iteratedDeriv n f 0 / n.factorial) * Polynomial.X ^ n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ (fun n hn => ?_)
    have : n ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
    exact (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans this
  · intro z
    have hs := Complex.hasSum_taylorSeries_of_entire hf 0 z
    have hfin := hs.unique (hasSum_sum_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.range (k + 1)) (fun n hn => by
      have : k < n := by
        have := Finset.mem_range.not.mp hn
        omega
      simp [hv n this]))
    rw [hfin, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
    simp
    ring
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (C : ℝ) (k : ℕ), Differentiable ℂ f → (∀ z, ‖f z‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ k) → ∃ p : Polynomial ℂ, p.natDegree ≤ k ∧ ∀ z, f z = p.eval z
